messages:
deploy-bot: starting canary rollout v1.12.0 -> api/runtime/console/router in tonight's change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. wave=1: 5% traffic to runtime v1.12.0, api/console/router unchanged. status hooks enabled. :rocket:
Sam (release-lead): notes and release docs: https://internal.redwood/release/v1.12.0 - key change: kernel batching + kv eviction tweak. Heads up: console UI tweak is behind feature-flag, but runtime kernel change could affect latency.
Aisha (runtime-eng): copying monitoring checklist: latency SLOs, p99 requests, KV miss rate, CUDA mem. If p99 latency > 220ms for >5m, we abort. Also plan to enable progressive batch size change in wave2.
Matt (api-eng): ok. For safety, we should pin API routing to previous model if runtime signals fail. Can we automate a pin?
Leah (console-eng): console depends on new model version for structured outputs but it's behind flag. I'd prefer console stays on previous until runtime stable. Can we do a staggered pin for console to stay at v1.11.9 by default?
Sam (release-lead): decision: wave1 only touches runtime. API & console remain on v1.11.9. Router will not route to new runtime nodes until 2nd wave. We'll keep a manual pin for console during the window.
Toni (oncall): I'm on pager. If we see error budget burn or increase in 500s, I'll signal abort. Recommend rollback matrix: 1) abort canary (stop traffic), 2) pin runtime back to v1.11.9 images, 3) force router to fall back to legacy pool.
Aisha (runtime-eng): I'll instrument a short-circuit for KV eviction param in prod flags so we can flip without full rollback. Also posting quick pin commands below: 
```
# pin runtime pool to previous image
curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood/api/pins -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"service":"runtime","env":"prod","version":"v1.11.9"}'
# pin console route
curl -X POST https://deploy.redwood/api/pins -d '{"service":"console","env":"prod","version":"v1.11.9"}'
```
Matt (api-eng): thanks, leaving a small probe to validate JWT signing latency too.
QA-bot: canary smoke checklist: startup health OK, kv metrics within baseline +/-5%, 1k synthetic requests at 5% traffic with no regressions.
Sam (release-lead): roll/abort criteria restated: abort if p99 latency >220ms for 5m OR error rate >0.5% sustained for 10m OR KV miss rate delta >8%. On abort, follow Toni's rollback matrix.
Leah (console-eng): I'll open a quick patch to set the console feature flag to off by default for wave1, and attach rollback instructions in the PR.
Toni (oncall): ready. Please ping @toni when you see a spike. I'll be monitoring infra channels and can hit the pin endpoints if needed. :eyes:
Aisha (runtime-eng): rolling wave1 now (runtime pool alpha-01 -> v1.12.0), canary ID c-8765. Will post updates every 2m.
deply-bot: deploy event: canary c-8765 started by Aisha at 23:02 UTC.
Aisha (runtime-eng): 2m update: p50/p95/p99 = 18/95/190ms, errors 0.03%, kv miss +1.2% -> within thresholds.
Sam (release-lead): :thumbsup: continue to wave2 plan after 10m stable, but do not touch console routing until we clear a 30m stability window.
Leah (console-eng): acknowledged, will not flip any console routes.
Toni (oncall): monitoring, will signal abort if threshold crossed.
Aisha (runtime-eng): 10m update: p99 = 205ms, kv miss +3.5%, errors 0.04% -> still OK. Preparing wave2 proposal (increase traffic to 20% and enable model batching tweak).
Sam (release-lead): wave2 postponed to 00:10 UTC to give extra buffer. Leave pins as-is.
Aisha (runtime-eng): acknowledged, will hold.
QA-bot: automated smoke passed for canary c-8765.
Sam (release-lead): final: wave1 continues holding. We'll reconvene at 00:05 for go/no-go. Thanks team.
